verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation that Nix verifies fetched sources or binary-cache downloads against checksums, signatures, or attestations before use. nix-docs-36 only says Nix can fetch pre-built binaries from a binary cache, with no mention of signature checks. The one community remark (nix-comm-19) says reproducible builds let someone compare hashes themselves; that is a user-side check enabled by reproducibility, not documented automatic verification before execution.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can trust that fetched packages are verified against checksums, signatures, or attestations before they run
